fix: add ISR revalidation to blog post pages to prevent scheduled post 404s

build time, caching 404s permanently even after the publish date passed.
Adding revalidate=3600 (matching the blog index) lets Next.js re-render
pages hourly so scheduled articles appear automatically.

refactor: simplify Cal.com to direct link, remove iframe/embed hacks

Cal.com blocks iframing via X-Frame-Options, and their embed-react
package has unfixable dark mode issues (Shadow DOM white background).

The cleanest approach: a simple <a> link to Cal.com with ?theme=dark.
Zero JS overhead, works perfectly on mobile, Cal.com handles its own
dark theme natively.

- CalPopupButton is now a server component (no 'use client')
- Remove all Cal.com CSP rules (no iframe/script needed)
- Tighter CSP: removed frame-src, cal.com from script/style/img/connect

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor: replace @calcom/embed-react with custom modal + iframe

The @calcom/embed-react popup uses Shadow DOM web components with
hardcoded light mode styles — no clean way to fix the white background.

Replace with a custom modal built with Framer Motion that loads
cal.com directly via iframe with ?theme=dark query param. This gives
us full control over the overlay, animations, and dark theme.

- Remove @calcom/embed-react dependency (saves ~50KB bundle)
- Custom modal with backdrop blur, scale animation, scroll lock
- Escape key and backdrop click to close
- Proper ARIA: role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-label
- useReducedMotion support
- No Shadow DOM, no MutationObserver, no CSS hacks

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: patch Cal.com shadow DOM white background in dark mode

The cal-modal-box web component uses Shadow DOM, making external CSS
unable to reach its .message-container div which defaults to white bg.
Use MutationObserver to detect modal insertion and inject dark theme
styles directly into the shadow root.
